explanation: Native retrieve re-encodes each query individually, while saved query vectors may use batches of four. BF16 kernels and padded batch shapes can change last-bit results; native torch.argsort tie behavior also differs from stable catalog-order NumPy sorting. These are possible causes, not proven explanations of every observed difference. Query truncation/chunk aggregation is another protocol difference if any query exceeded16384 tokens. Matching output is not an independent model improvement.
latency: Native includes query embedding plus search, whereas cached cosine does not.
